Simple Grilled Veggies
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Thursday, August 20, 2015 - 9:36am

Ingredients




Your choice of fresh veggies. Almost any will work.
Cauliflower
Broccoli
Asparagus
1/4 olive oil
1/8 cup Tuscan Herb olive oil
1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning
Salt & pepper to taste
3/4 tsp. pepper blend seasoning
1/2 fresh lemon

Preparation

1 Wash, drain and cut veggies. 2 For the marinade combine: 3 1/8 cup Olive oil 4 1/8 cup Tuscan Herb olive oil 5 1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning 6 Salt & pepper to taste 7 Marinate the cauliflower & broccoli for 30-60 minutes in a ziplock bag at room temperature prior to grilling 8 Just before grilling drizzle the asparagus with olive oil 9 Season with 3/4 tsp. pepper blend seasoning 10 Salt to taste 11 Heat the BBQ to medium 12 Place basket on grill 13 Pop in seasoned veggies 14 Cook until desired doneness, turning often 15 Squeeze fresh lemon juice over cooked veggies 16 ENJOY!!

About

Simple Grilled Veggies is one of those dishes that is quick, easy and certainly fits the saying that sometimes "simple is best".  Crunchy, grilled and seasoned to perfection, it's a dish that goes with any meat, fish or seafood.
